title: Add contextual short response permission logic to compile_context step in chatbot/core/steps.py
description:
Modify the compile_context step in chatbot/core/steps.py to implement contextual short response permission logic. This logic determines if the chatbot has permission to reply with a short response based on conversational context.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/core/steps.py compile_context definition.
acceptance_criteria: Contextual short response permission logic is executed during the compile_context step
